limitations.m4_numeric_bin_circularity: CRITICAL, DISCLOSED FINDING: the NO_INTEGER_VALUE category of C_NUMERIC is tautologically entangled with Y by construction of the underlying token representation -- a numeral token has numeric_value=None if and only if it was created via the fraction-only code path in src/lineara_adapter.py, which ALWAYS carries a non-empty .fractions list. Empirically, all 17/17 rows with numeric_value=None have fraction_present=True (100%), accounting for 17 of the 38 total positives (44.7%). Among the 219 rows WITH a resolvable integer value (excluding NO_INTEGER_VALUE), the marginal fraction-presence rate is roughly flat across bins (SMALL 10.8%, MEDIUM 11.1%, LARGE 6.8%) -- no clear magnitude gradient. M4's large, Holm-significant ΔH4 is therefore very likely driven substantially, plausibly predominantly, by this structural artifact rather than a genuine 'quantity magnitude predicts fraction usage' relationship. This does NOT change the mechanically-computed, frozen-protocol verdict (M4: SUPPORTED) -- it is reported as the single most important interpretive caveat on that verdict, discovered via a purely descriptive post-hoc check, per this round's own adversarial-audit requirement. No rebinning, category merge, or protocol change was made in response.
